title: lumnitzera tenuiflora
intro: Lumnitzera tenuiflora, commonly known as white mangrove or Java plum, is a plant species native to the coastal regions of Southeast Asia and the Pacific islands. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lumnitzera tenuiflora include its ability to exhibit immunomodulatory, hepatoprotective, and antidiabetic effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been isolated and studied in various scientific research.
